text: cool so then finally to be crystal clear: if i have code updates on mac, i just commit them as normal. and then pull on this machine
resolution: Clarified the final direction split: code authored on the Mac uses the normal Git add/commit/push workflow and is received on the desktop with git pull --ff-only; editor-sync push is intentionally limited to models, maps, and content data, while editor-sync pull flows desktop files to the Mac and does not transport Mac code back.
